arxiv-2108-10593.title: Uniform approximation of continuous couplings
arxiv-2108-10593.creator: Ugo Bindini and Tapio Rajala
arxiv-2108-10593.description: Abstract . We study the approximation of non-negative multi-variate couplings in the uniform norm while matching given single-variable marginal constraints. 1. Introduction For some integer N\geq 2 , let (X_{1},d_{1},\mu_{1}),\dotsc,(X_{N},d_{N},\mu_{N}) be probabilistic metric spaces and (X,d,\mu) the product space X=X_{1}\times\dotsb\times X_{N} equipped with the product measure \mu=\mu_{1}\otimes\dotsb\otimes\mu_{N} and the distance d(x,x^{\prime})=\sum_{j=1}^{N}d_{j}(x_{j},x_{j}^{\prime}).

arxiv-2111-03788.title: d3rlpy: An Offline Deep Reinforcement Learning Library
arxiv-2111-03788.creator: Takuma Seno seno@ailab.ics.keio.ac.jp, Michita Imai michita@ailab.ics.keio.ac.jp
arxiv-2111-03788.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Takuma Seno seno@ailab.ics.keio.ac.jp, Michita Imai michita@ailab.ics.keio.ac.jp. In this paper, we introduce d3rlpy , an open-sourced offline deep reinforcement learning (RL) library for Python. d3rlpy supports a set of offline deep RL algorithms as well as off-policy online algorithms via a fully documented plug-and-play API. To address a reproducibility issue, we conduct a large-scale benchmark with D4RL and Atari 2600 dataset to ensure implementation quality and provide experimental scripts and full tables of results. The d3rlpy source code can be found on GitHub: https://github.com/takuseno/d3rlpy .

arxiv-2210-01304.title: Derived Character Maps of Group Representations
arxiv-2210-01304.creator: Yuri Berest, Ajay C. Ramadoss
arxiv-2210-01304.description: Abstract . In this paper, we construct and study derived character maps of finite-dimensional representations of ∞ \infty -groups. As models for ∞ \infty -groups we take homotopy simplicial groups, i.e. homotopy simplicial 𝔊 op {\mathfrak{G}}^{\rm op} -algebras over the algebraic theory of groups (in the sense of [ 4 ] ).

arxiv-2312-17296.title: Structured Packing in LLM Training Improves Long Context Utilization
arxiv-2312-17296.creator: Konrad Staniszewski, Szymon Tworkowski, Sebastian Jaszczur, Yu Zhao, Henryk Michalewski, Łukasz Kuciński, Piotr Miłoś
arxiv-2312-17296.description: Abstract Recent advancements in long-context language modeling have attracted significant attention, yet their practical applications often suffer from suboptimal context utilization. To efficiently address this issue, we introduce the Structured Packing for Long Context, SPLiCe , a method that uses retrieval to collate mutually relevant documents into long training samples.

arxiv-2403-14296.title: Optimal prevention strategies for chronic diseases in a compartmental disease trajectory model
arxiv-2403-14296.creator: Katharina Ledebur, Alexandra Kautzky-Willer, Stefan Thurner, Peter Klimek
arxiv-2403-14296.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Katharina Ledebur, Alexandra Kautzky-Willer, Stefan Thurner, Peter Klimek. In countries with growing elderly populations, multimorbidity poses a significant healthcare challenge. Despite its pressing development, important questions remain on how to model the development of multimorbidity. Leveraging a comprehensive dataset from approximately 45 million hospital stays spanning 17 years in Austria, we propose a compartmental model, traditionally used in infectious diseases, describing chronic disease trajectories across 132 distinct multimorbidity patterns (compartments).

arxiv-2405-10841.title: The ESO SupJup Survey I: Chemical and isotopic characterisation of the late L-dwarf DENIS J0255-4700 with CRIRES +
arxiv-2405-10841.creator: S. de Regt, S. Gandhi, I. A. G. Snellen, Y. Zhang, C. Ginski, D. González Picos, A. Y. Kesseli, R. Landman, P. Mollière, E. Nasedkin, A. Sánchez-López, T. Stolker
arxiv-2405-10841.description: Abstract Context. It has been proposed that the distinct formation and evolutionary pathways of exoplanets and brown dwarfs may affect the chemical and isotopic content of their atmospheres. Recent work has indeed shown differences in the C 12 / 13 C \mathrm{{}^{12}C/^{13}C} isotope ratio, provisionally attributed to the top-down formation of brown dwarfs and the core accretion pathway of super-Jupiters.

arxiv-2406-16376.title: Multi-Objective Global Path Planning for Lunar Exploration With a Quadruped Robot
arxiv-2406-16376.creator: Julia Richter, Hendrik Kolvenbach, Giorgio Valsecchi, Marco Hutter
arxiv-2406-16376.description: Abstract In unstructured environments the best path is not always the shortest, but needs to consider various objectives like energy efficiency, risk of failure or scientific outcome. This paper proposes a global planner, based on the A* algorithm, capable of individually considering multiple layers of map data for different cost objectives.

arxiv-2408-11061.title: StructuredRAG: JSON Response Formatting with Large Language Models
arxiv-2408-11061.creator: Connor Shorten, Charles Pierse, Thomas Benjamin Smith, Erika Cardenas, Akanksha Sharma, John Trengrove, Bob van Luijt
arxiv-2408-11061.description: Abstract The ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate structured outputs, such as JSON, is crucial for their use in Compound AI Systems. However, evaluating and improving this capability remains challenging. In this work, we introduce StructuredRAG, a benchmark of six tasks designed to assess LLMs’ proficiency in following response format instructions. We evaluate two state-of-the-art LLMs, Gemini 1.

arxiv-2505-22100.title: Symmetry reduction for testing k k -block-positivity via extendibility
arxiv-2505-22100.creator: Qian Chen, Benoît Collins, Omar Fawzi
arxiv-2505-22100.description: Abstract We study the problem of testing k k -block-positivity via symmetric N N -extendibility by taking the tensor product with a k k -dimensional maximally entangled state. We exploit the unitary symmetry of the maximally entangled state to reduce the size of the corresponding semidefinite programs (SDP).

arxiv-2506-23687.title: Dynamic modes of active Potts models with factorizable numbers of states
arxiv-2506-23687.creator: Hiroshi Noguchi
arxiv-2506-23687.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hiroshi Noguchi. We studied the long-term nonequilibrium dynamics of q q -state Potts models with q = 4 q=4 , 5 5 , 6 6 , and 8 8 using Monte Carlo simulations on a two-dimensional square lattice. When the contact energies between the nearest neighbors for the standard Potts models are used, cyclic changes in the q q homogeneous phases and q q -state coexisting wave mode appear at low and high flipping energies, respectively, for all values of q q .

arxiv-2509-17009.title: Antiferromagnetic nonreciprocity of light emission in CuB 2 O 4
arxiv-2509-17009.creator: A. R. Nurmukhametov, 1 D. R. Yakovlev, 2,3 V. Yu. Ivanov, 4 D. Kudlacik, 2 M. V. Eremin, 1 R. V. Pisarev, 3 and M. Bayer 2,5
arxiv-2509-17009.description: Abstract Nonreciprocity of light emission, when the radiation intensity differs for two opposite propagation directions, is a rare phenomenon in solids because it requires a violation of the crystal symmetry with respect to time-reversal. Such violation via time-reversal symmetry breaking can occur either due to an applied magnetic field or due to a magnetic ordering.
